description: Vessel displacement and deadweight estimate from hull dimensions: volume = length × beam × draught × block coefficient; displacement = volume × water density (sea 1.025, fresh 1.000 t/m³); deadweight = displacement − lightship weight (if given). Also returns the cargo capacity left after fuel, stores and ballast you enter. A design-stage estimate from standard formulas, not a vessel's official DWT; no ship registry lookup. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

blockCoefficient.description: Block coefficient Cb, 0.35-0.90 (default 0.75; tankers/bulkers ~0.8-0.85, container ships ~0.6-0.7)

consumablesTonnes.description: Optional fuel, fresh water, stores and ballast on board, tonnes

lightshipTonnes.description: Optional lightship weight in tonnes, to get deadweight
